title: Exact linear descent of coefficient equivalences and mixed pullback comparisons
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $T$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]; such schemes are called allowed. For each finite $E\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, use the framework integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^s(T)$ of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and the PBC integral category and raw rationalization $\mathcal C_E^p(T)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category].
For each allowed scheme $W$, suppose given exact $E$-linear equivalences $J_{W,E}:\mathcal C_E^s(W)\simeq\mathcal C_E^p(W)$ and exact natural scalar comparisons $j_{W,L/E}:J_{W,L}S_{L/E}\simeq P_{L/E}J_{W,E}$. Here $S,P$ and their associators $a^s,a^p$ are the actual transitions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition, prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Assume the identity normalization, compatibility with shifts and the scalar cocycle
$$a^p_{M,L,E}\circ P_{M/L}(j_{W,L/E})\circ j_{W,M/L,S_{L/E}K}=j_{W,M/E}\circ J_{W,M}(a^s_{M,L,E}).$$
On the literal pair categories $\mathcal C_W$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and $\mathcal P_W$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], the formulas
$$J_W(E,K)=(E,J_{W,E}K),\qquad J_W[L,u]=[L,j_{W,L/F,H}\circ J_{W,L}(u)\circ j_{W,L/E,K}^{-1}]$$
for $u:S_{L/E}K\to S_{L/F}H$ define exact $\Omega$-linear equivalences. At every common stage this conjugation is a Hom bijection commuting with further scalar transport, and it and its inverse descend to inverse Hom-colimit maps. The functors preserve finite-stage inclusions, shifts and common-stage distinguished triangles in both directions, with no Karoubi completion.
Suppose additionally that for each allowed scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$ there are natural finite rational comparisons $b_{h,E}:J_{U,E}F^s_{h,E}\simeq F^p_{h,E}J_{T,E}$ of the actual pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Assume their mixed scalar square, namely
$$F^p_{h,L}(j_T)\circ b_{h,L,S_TK}\circ J_{U,L}(\alpha^s_K)=\alpha^p_{J_{T,E}K}\circ P_U(b_{h,E,K})\circ j_{U,F^s_{h,E}K},$$
where $\alpha^s:S_UF^s_{h,E}\to F^s_{h,L}S_T$ and $\alpha^p:P_UF^p_{h,E}\to F^p_{h,L}P_T$ are the specified rational scalar/pullback comparisons. Then the finite-stage classes of $b_{h,E,K}$ define natural isomorphisms $b_h:J_UF_h^s\simeq F_h^pJ_T$ for the actual common-stage pullbacks. Any identity, composition, shift and scalar equations satisfied by the finite $b$ hold for these descended comparisons. When the finite equivalences and comparisons have the normalized integral lifts, these constructions supply precisely the common-stage fields of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum, def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum].
